title: Electronic Patient-Reported Outcome Monitoring With Alert-Based Interventions in Metastatic Breast Cancer
comparison_or_design: The primary electronic-PRO monitoring comparison in metastatic breast cancer.
excluded: 9/12-month trajectories, emotional functioning and other PRO domains
Subgroups, missing-data sensitivities, healthcare utilization and survival
population_or_material: The article-defined modified intention-to-treat population with metastatic breast cancer.
requested_items: Use the main baseline table for observed arm-level baseline means/SD and the primary Results paragraphs for six-month adjusted fatigue arm means and three domain treatment differences/CI. Exclude combined-cohort summaries, baseline significance tests, changes, sensitivity/imputed-model presentations in other figures and protocol-planned populations.
case_specific_rules: Use the baseline PRO table for requested baseline arm summaries. If the abstract or narrative Results repeats a different baseline mean, retain the table value and the discrepancy in the review record. Keep the six-month model analysis separate from baseline descriptives.
